title: Care Desk Guidance on Title & Registration Services State Fees When a Customer Buys Several Vehicles
content:
Title & Registration Services state fees are computed per title order and are never combined across a customer's orders. Two vehicles bought the same day each carry their own title, registration, plate, lien and temp tag fees.

A plate transferred to one vehicle cannot also be transferred to another. A plate is transferred only to one open title order of the same customer.

## The rule restated

| Situation | Treatment |
|---|---|
| A customer buys two vehicles on the same day | each title order carries its own state fees; none is shared or combined |
| A customer has one plate to transfer and two open title orders | the plate is transferred to one of those orders only |
| A plate belongs to a different customer | it is not transferred to this customer's order |

## Basis questions

**Can the title fee paid on one order count toward the title fee of the customer's second vehicle?**
No. Each order's state fees are computed for that order alone and are never combined across orders.

**Can the same plate be transferred to two of a customer's vehicles?**
No. A plate transferred to one vehicle cannot also be transferred to another; it goes to one open title order of the same customer.
